subStrands.name: Personal Safety, Regulations and Machine Safety

objectives.description: Personal safety precautions; general workshop safety regulations; safety devices and appliances; hand tool safety.

Machine safety: general machine shop safety; safety precautions in the use of portable power tools and machines; safety in machine operations; prevention of mechanical faults. First aid: materials and administration.

subStrands.name: Hand Tools, Special Purpose Tools and Machines

objectives.description: Hand tools: types; classification (geometrical, holding and supporting, impelling and percussion, cutting, boring, abrading and scraping tools); identification, description, types and uses; safety precautions in carrying, storing and handling.

Special purpose hand tools: planes (spokeshaves, rebate plane, plough plane, block plane, shoulder plane); saws (bow saw, pad/keyhole saw, coping saw, fret saw); boring bits (expansion bit, forstner bit, countersink bit, auger bit).
Woodworking machines: types, identification, uses, operation, care and maintenance; safety precautions in machine operations.

subStrands.name: Joints, Wood Materials and Construction Methods

objectives.description: Widening joints: plain/simple butt, dowelled, tongued and grooved, rebated butt.

Angle joints (box-like): common and lapped dovetail, pin joints. Shelf-like construction: housing joints, pinned joints, dowelled, plain mitre. Framing joints: mortise and tenon, bridle and lapped joints, mitre, dowelled.

Wood materials: solid wood (types of timber — hardwood and softwood; characteristics, properties and uses; seasoning and defects); manufactured boards (plywood, blockboard, chipboard, hardboard, MDF — manufacture, characteristics and uses); non-wood materials; adhesives (types, properties and uses).

Technical drawing: drawing tools and their uses; types of drawing (isometric, oblique, orthographic projection); dimensioning; construction of geometric shapes; reading and interpreting working drawings; drawing to scale.
Design: elements and principles of design; following a design brief; producing working drawings; interpretation of working drawings.

Methods and principles of construction: practical operations (cutting — ripping, cross-cutting; planing — surfacing, thicknessing; shaping — chamfering, rounding, tapering; assembling and finishing — testing for squareness, parallelism, trial assembly, cramping, surface preparation, application of finishes).

strands.name: Surface Decoration, Mass Production and Entrepreneurship

subStrands.name: Surface Decoration, Mass Production and Business in Woodworking

objectives.description: Surface decoration: types (inlaying, veneering, marquetry, lamination, laminated plastics, mouldings); identification, description, processes, techniques and application.

Mass production: concept and principles; processes (market survey, design, production, quality assurance, sales/marketing, management, procurement, cost estimation, tooling up for production); mass production terms (templates, fixtures, trial run, departments, prototype, quality control).

Entrepreneurship in Woodworking (Nigeria): types of business organisation (sole proprietorship, partnership, cooperatives); business opportunities (merchandising, spray painting, upholstery work, wood turning); business plans (format and content); sources of fund (gifts, personal savings, loans, inheritance, cooperatives).
